description: The one project file: `[project]` metadata and dependencies, `[build-system]` backend, `[dependency-groups]` and `[tool.*]` settings.
A directory with its own interpreter entry point and `site-packages`; running its `python` selects its packages.
The exact resolved versions (and hashes) of every dependency, committed so every machine installs the same set.
A linter and formatter in one binary that replaces Flake8, isort and Black in most projects.
mypy, pyright or ty: a separate step that reads annotations, which the interpreter itself never enforces.
